content:
Apple raised trade-in values for most product lines just last month, but has updated them again following its "Surprise and Shine" event — this time lowering iPhone trade-in values while raising iPad and most Mac values. Here are the latest trade-in values.

Apple now accepts the iPhone Air and iPhone 17 lineup for trade-in.

Last month, Apple adjusted trade-in pricing for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch models, Mac, and Android devices, with some devices seeing trade-in value increases of nearly 30%.

Today, Apple updated trade-in values once again, with all iPhone models seeing their maximum trade-in amounts reduced, some by as much as $120.

Meanwhile, the entire iPad lineup and all Mac models (except Mac Pro) have seen their trade-in values raised, while Apple Watch and Android device trade-in prices have mostly been reduced or remain unchanged.
